title: Ja'Marr Chase wins appeal of fines for making an obscene gesture

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ja'Marr Chase wins appeal of fines for making an obscene gesture
sources.description: Bengals wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase was fined twice for making an obscene gesture during the team's Week 2 win over the Texans, but he won't be forking over any money to the league.
